WITH per_step AS (
  SELECT step, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users FROM src GROUP BY step
), baseline AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN step = 'view' THEN users ELSE 0 END) AS view_users FROM per_step
)
SELECT p.step, p.users,
       ROUND(100.0 * p.users / NULLIF(b.view_users, 0), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM per_step AS p CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
ORDER BY CASE p.step WHEN 'view' THEN 0 WHEN 'cart' THEN 1
                WHEN 'checkout' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

recipe.name: funnel
recipe.description: Count distinct users per funnel step and compute conversion relative to the view step.
